$comment: Public Google Drive folders mirrored into assets/images/gallery/<name>/ by
see the Galleries section of README.md.
name     - directory under assets/images/product/, and what the {{< gallery >}}
folderId - the Drive folder id, or just paste the whole folder URL. The folder
must be shared 'Anyone with the link -> Viewer'.
title    - human-readable name, this will be the title of the gallery on the website
minFiles - optional. Fail the build if fewer than this many images come back.
Drive's public folder view truncates large folders silently, so set
this a little below the real count on any big gallery.
JSON rather than YAML like the rest of data/ so the sync script can parse it
with the standard library; Hugo reads both the same way.
